title: It is possible to still have stack frames that can be expanded if the frame pointer is omitted.
summary: With frame-pointer omission, registers such as RBP can be repurposed. An unwinder can reconstruct the call chain from call frame information.
applies: Offline stack traceback, symbol matching and debugging information for native programs
detail: When interpreting normal calls after compilation, the lack of a fixed frame pointer prologue to a function does not directly indicate that the traceback is broken.
boundary: Omission strategies vary by target and function; tracebacks may also be incomplete in the absence of matching unwind information.
relevance: When diagnosing missing frames, priority is given to distinguishing between compilation strategies and insufficient log collection.
